name: Maya, Valentina, Naomi
source:
You step into a world of new beginnings. The lecture halls are waiting, but the real lessons happen between classes. Explore a vibrant university campus, navigate the chaos of the clubs fair, and decide who you want to become.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4216960/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你步入一个新开始的世界。演讲厅正在等待，但真正的课程发生在课间。探索充满活力的大学校园，在俱乐部展会的混乱中穿行，并决定你想成为谁。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4216960/]Steam[/url]]
